biography.use: He/him and teaching/scholar identity; not additional invented positions.

objective: Answer an objection while advancing the claim
fiction: All encounters, characters other than Young, imagined dialogue and outcomes are invented. Only explicitly labelled excerpts reproduce the article. The bathroom/computer joke is user-requested fictional dialogue. Jordan is one fictional person, not a representative of all African American English speakers. The Chicago university workshop in 2011 is an invented setting, not a claim that Young gave this lecture there.
aiScope: Five trusted source cards, including Young’s first-person faculty statement and a fixed rubric. No claim to simulate consciousness or access to an unverified corpus. Supports revision without grades. Card references and plausible inferences are separated.

scoring.revisionPolicy: Highest assessed revision counts; first response and all feedback preserved. No gradebook posting. Version 1 retained with original scoring.

readingBoundary: Young essay only: printed pp. 110–117 and author note on 118; the next article on PDF page 10 is outside the boundary.
